title: Set 278

sentences.ko: 잘 되긴 하는데, 미리 솔직하게 말씀드리면 배터리가 이제 충전이 거의 안 돼서 계속 꽂아 두고 쓰셔야 해요. 그래서 40달러만 받는 거예요.
sentences.text: It works fine, I just want to be upfront that the battery doesn't really hold a charge anymore, so you'd have to keep it plugged in. That's why I'm only asking forty bucks for it.

alts.text: Works fine, but heads up, the battery's pretty much dead, so it's gotta stay plugged in. That's why it's only forty bucks.
It functions properly, but I should be honest that the battery no longer holds a charge, so it would need to remain plugged in. That is why I am asking only forty dollars for it.

sentences.note: **be upfront** 는 숨기지 않고 미리 털어놓는다는 뜻이에요. **hold a charge** 는 배터리가 충전된 상태를 유지한다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 나도 그러고 싶은데, 이번 주는 매일 밤 일이 있었어. 집에서 조용히 쉬는 저녁이 하루라도 없으면 진짜 돌아버릴 것 같아. 다음 주말에 하면 안 될까?
sentences.text: I wish I could, but I've had something going on every night this week, and if I don't get one quiet evening at home I'm going to lose it. Can we do it next weekend instead?

alts.text: Ugh, I'd love to, but I've been out every night this week, and if I don't get a night in I'm gonna lose it. Next weekend?
I would like to, but I have had commitments every evening this week, and if I do not get one quiet evening at home, I will be completely worn out. Would it be possible to do it next weekend instead?

sentences.note: **lose it** 은 참다 참다 폭발하거나 정신이 나갈 것 같다는 말이에요. **something going on** 은 일정이나 할 일이 있다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 별거 안 했어. 차고 정리하려고 했는데 토요일 내내 비가 와서 그냥 집에 있으면서 네가 말해 준 그 드라마를 한 여섯 편쯤 봤어. 이제 네가 왜 그렇게 입에 달고 살았는지 좀 알겠더라.
sentences.text: Honestly, not much. I was going to clean out the garage, but it rained all Saturday, so I just stayed in and watched like six episodes of that show you told me about. And now I kind of get why you wouldn't shut up about it.

alts.text: Not much, really. Was gonna clean the garage, but it rained all Saturday, so I stayed in and binged like six episodes of that show you mentioned. Now I kinda get why you kept going on about it.

To be honest, not a great deal. I had planned to clean out the garage, but it rained all of Saturday, so I stayed home and watched about six episodes of the show you recommended. I now understand why you spoke about it so often.

sentences.note: **wouldn't shut up about it** 은 그 얘기를 멈추지 않았다, 입에 달고 살았다는 뜻이에요. **kind of get** 은 좀 이해가 간다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 우유랑 빵 사러 들어갔는데 어쩌다 보니 40달러를 썼어. 재밌는 걸 산 것도 아니고 그냥 늘 사는 것들이었는데, 계속 이 생각만 들더라. 언제 이렇게 다 비싸졌지?
sentences.text: I went in for milk and bread and somehow spent forty dollars. I didn't even get anything fun, it was just the normal stuff, and I kept thinking, when did all this get so expensive?

alts.text: Ran in for milk and bread and somehow dropped forty bucks. Nothing fun either, just regular stuff, and I'm like, since when is everything this pricey?
I went to the store for milk and bread and somehow spent forty dollars. I did not buy anything special, only the usual items, and I kept wondering when everything had become so expensive.

sentences.note: **somehow** 는 나도 모르게, 어쩌다 보니라는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **dropped forty bucks** 는 40달러를 썼다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 윗집 애들이 매일 밤 열 시쯤까지 왔다 갔다 뛰어다니는데, 그래, 애들이니까 이해는 해. 근데 난 일찍 출근하니까, 걔네가 겨우 멈출 때쯤이면 신경이 너무 곤두서서 잠이 안 와.
sentences.text: The kids upstairs run back and forth every night until like ten, and I get it, they're kids. But I work early, so by the time they finally stop, I'm too wound up to fall asleep.

alts.text: Those kids upstairs are running around every night till like ten, and yeah, they're kids. But I'm up early, so when they finally quit, I'm way too wired to sleep.

The children who live upstairs run back and forth every evening until around ten, and I understand that they are children. However, I start work early, so by the time they stop, I am too restless to fall asleep.

sentences.note: **wound up** 은 긴장하거나 흥분해서 가라앉지 않는 상태예요. **I get it** 은 이해한다, 알겠다는 뜻이에요.

2번 formal: lose it 의 세기가 빠지고 뜻이 눅어져서 지칠 대로 지칠 것이라는 말을 되살림
5번 casual: The upstairs kids run 이 text 첫머리와 겹쳐 Those kids upstairs are running 으로 바꿈
